scope: Actual vendored editor runtime in JSDOM; no native browser or passkey claim.

coverage: Literal text and Unicode via both actual editor APIs
No active HTML/image rendering from document text
Textarea upstream Markdown highlighting and contenteditable line normalization
CodeMirror editing, toolbar formatting, undo and redo
Attempted network/storage/URL/service-worker boundary traps during exercised flows
Editor disposal and rejected subsequent API use

limits: Native typing, browser CSP and responsive presentation are checked by the composed client.
Two ContinuityKit-written adapters, no upstream adoption or external maintainer endorsement.
Changing appId does not isolate applications from the shared reserve-origin operator.
